https://www.itv.com/news/calendar/2025-0.title: Murder arrest after injured driver dies at roadside in Newark
https://www.itv.com/news/calendar/2025-0.text:
A man has been arrested on suspicion of murder over the death of a driver who had reportedly suffered a medical emergency.
Police were called to Lombard Street, in Newark, at about 5pm on Monday following reports of an injured man in distress.
A Nottinghamshire Police spokesperson said: "The man had been driving when he reportedly suffered a medical emergency so pulled over."
He died at the scene.
A 19-year-old man has been arrested on suspicion of murder.
A 37-year-old woman and a 16-year-old girl were arrested on suspicion of assisting an offender.
Detective Chief Inspector Ruby Burrow, of Nottinghamshire Police, said: “While we’re announcing news of these arrests today, I’d stress that this murder investigation is still very much ongoing.
“As such, it is critical that anyone who has any information but hasn’t told us about it yet, does so immediately."
